summary: Verified 'Uncaught runtime errors' CRA overlay bug fix. Navigated all 9 public pages + /admin with pageerror and console listeners. Stress-tested aggressive viewport resizes (1920x800->500x900->1280x700->375x812->1920x800) with Lenis scroll up/down. Rapid category-chip clicking + search fill/clear on /menu. Gallery lightbox open/next/prev/close on /galeri. Reservation form fill on /rezervasyon. Mobile hamburger toggle at 390x844. Cookie banner accept. Admin Google login button verified. NO webpack-dev-server overlay iframe appeared anywhere. NO uncaught page errors. Regression assertions passed: hero 'EFSANE LEZZET' visible, /menu shows 4 categories, /admin shows Google login button.
critical_code_review_comments: Overlay fix in craco.config.js (client.overlay.runtimeErrors filter) and global ResizeObserver suppression in src/index.js are effective — no runtime overlay observed under stress.
Console shows expected 401s from admin auth check (/api/auth/me) on public load — harmless but could be silenced with a session-cache guard to reduce noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Overlay bug fix confirmed working. All public pages, resize/scroll stress, menu chip rapid-click, gallery lightbox, reservation form, mobile hamburger, cookie banner, and admin page all pass with zero page errors and no overlay. Only console noise is 401 from /api/auth/me which is expected when unauthenticated.
